name: review-check-stale-cache
title: sd-review gates on a memoized check that reads live inputs
description: The review coordinator computes the typed sd-check once per attempt (run, templates/scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review.py:1827-1830) and gates every later run at the same head on the memoized report; state["check"] is never invalidated. pack.review-scope reads the live PR body via gh pr view --json body, and the attempt identity records prNumber but not the body, while worktreeDigest is None for PR scope -- so once a failure is cached at a head, hand-authoring the scope section cannot clear it, false-blocking the post-finalization successor-head review. knowledge.obsidian-kb is a second live-input check but is NOT a blocking example for an external-symlinked KB: 7865666c (first in v0.64.22) downgrades that failure to skipped, which is absent from AGGREGATE_PRECEDENCE. A consumer repository already carries a local fix that this pack reverts on every refresh.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Found from a consumer (platypeeps/se-ai-command-pack) on 2026-08-07, same route as the three defects filed in 6f810484 from auditing hoa-manager. That consumer already carries the reference fix as a local fork of an install: "always" file -- bc01bc2 extracts _resolve_check and ships 5 guard tests -- so this pack reverts the fix on every refresh of it. _resolve_check exists in no version here (checked all 33 v0.6* tags across 1975 commits). Confirmed 2026-08-07: refreshing that consumer 0.64.3 -> 0.64.27 removed the fix and errored all 5 tests, so the refresh was reverted and the consumer is still on 0.64.3, behind 23 tagged releases (v0.64.4 through v0.64.27; v0.64.25 was never tagged -- 24 is the patch delta, not the release count). The 5 guard tests stub _run_check, so they pin the recompute contract but do not reproduce a live-input failure. bc01bc2's message also cites knowledge.obsidian-kb; that half was correct against 0.64.3 but is superseded by 7865666c, so do not carry it forward. Read bc01bc2 before designing a different remedy. Consumer-side record is tracked there as 08-07-review-py-local-fork.
